author: d7
decision: READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT; NOT AUTHORIZED FOR SEMANTIC ADMISSION
problemStatement: Sequential v3 ranking reached 6 KEEP / 19 REJECT in batch18. V4 therefore stops consuming the same exhausted rank order and mines structurally different sources.

sourceLanes.definition: An entire 3-12 graph CJK span between corpus punctuation boundaries, with at least 8 attestations and 6 canonical works.
A 3-8 graph collocation with at least 20 attestations and minimum cohesion across every internal split of at least 3 bits.
sourceLanes.interpretation: Useful only in combination with complete-boundary or construction evidence; weak as a standalone admission signal.

sourceLanes.definition: Attested bounded Chan action verb plus ritual/encounter object, support at least 5.
sourceLanes.interpretation: High observed precision but only three settled rows; sample is too small for autonomous use.

sourceLanes.definition: A complete punctuation-bounded clause containing but extending a settled KEEP family member; it proposes uncovered family structure and never inherits the family disposition.
sourceLanes.interpretation: Novel-gap lane cannot be truth-tested by exact identity without ceasing to be a gap; every output still requires full-case review.

backtest.comparison: The measured v4 top-25 association is 68% KEEP versus frequency batch18's realized 24% KEEP. This is an association/backtest result, not a prospective yield guarantee.
limitations: The feature thresholds were motivated by prior failure analysis, so the settled backtest is not an untouched holdout.
Lane memberships overlap; lane counts must not be summed as independent observations.
Exact identity dedupe does not replace manual synonym, variant, containment, or authority-family collision review.
Action-object backtest n=3 is too small to justify automatic preference or admission.

dedupeAudit.correctionHistory: A pre-handoff audit caught an initial non-recursive fresh-build glob that bound zero nested entries. The generator was corrected to fresh-build/entries/*/entry.v2.json and the overlay was fully regenerated; no superseded overlay was retained.
